scientific_role: disjoint replication of the candidate-universe result; not selector validation and not a change to the validated Japanese ACSP product
question: Across previously unused Cirsium taxa, does a training-only fixed regional broad land universe recover novel later populations that a bounded LOCAL frame cannot represent?

cohort_selection.selection_basis: external distribution/habitat descriptions plus absence from prior ACSP repository analyses; no 2021-2025 occurrence counts used

units.source_distribution_summary: Japanese endemic reported from Shikoku and Kyushu; grassland species, sometimes on limestone
Japanese endemic reported from Honshu, Shikoku and Kyushu on Pacific coastal grassland, beaches and rocky/gravel coast
Japanese endemic reported from Shikoku, associated with cool-temperate forest edge

fixed_region_registry.selection_rule: For each unit, among externally allowed fixed regions choose the region with the largest number of strict 2000-2020 population clusters; ties follow the existing VALIDATED_JAPAN_REGIONS order. If all allowed regions have zero strict historical populations, retain the unit as NO_HISTORICAL_ANCHOR and do not replace it.

land_filter.mode: official 3-degree COG point sampling at frozen candidate coordinates

outcome.novel_population_rule: Apply the same declared uncertainty <=1 km rule, then deterministic complete-link 0.5 km; a recent cluster is novel when >0.5 km from every strict historical population in the selected fixed region

primary_endpoint.contrast: BROAD_LAND full-frame recall minus LOCAL_5KM_LAND full-frame recall at 1.0 km
primary_endpoint.unit_weighting: report every unit; pooled cluster-weighted result is secondary to unit-level signs
primary_endpoint.replication_support_rule: At least 2 of 3 frozen units must be temporally evaluable, and at least 2 temporally evaluable units must have a strictly positive BROAD_LAND minus LOCAL_5KM_LAND recall difference at 1.0 km.
primary_endpoint.zero_recent_or_zero_novel_units: retained as non-evaluable/zero-information, never replaced after outcome opening

secondary_outputs: candidate counts and strict historical/recent/novel population counts for every frozen unit
forbidden: do not change species after opening 2021-2025 outcomes
do not change allowed regions after opening 2021-2025 outcomes
do not select a region using recent outcomes
do not relax the 1000-m historical or recent precision rules after seeing evaluability
do not treat missing recent coordinate uncertainty as evaluable after seeing outcomes
do not tune LOCAL radii after seeing outcomes
do not fit or nominate a structural selector from this frame-ceiling replication
do not call broad full-frame reachability field efficiency, occupancy probability, or exact-site prediction
do not modify the independently validated Japanese 2.5% / 10-km candidate-patch product
